attacks.claim_at_risk: Finite readings might be reported as a proof of a limit or as measurements of the wrong volume.
attacks.method: Compared the four declared sources and two metrics with the owner's request. Meeting-volume, restricted positive bond witnesses, and conditional finite shape evidence have separate reference truths and nonclaims.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Names, coordinate data, rendering, history, source size, panel correspondence, or per-family missingness could convey a source label.
attacks.method: Only common count, neighborhood and positive-certificate columns go to the main reader. The shape reader gets numeric matrices, independent identifiers and a common censor mask. The source key and root routing belong to custody. Source eligibility of the shape panel is disclosed.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Calibration on test scales or treating three roots as independent constructions could inflate generality.
attacks.method: Disjoint development depths/radii are stated. A fresh secret supplies sampling and independent row ordering. The per-family denominator is three correlated roots and no confidence interval is attached to four appointed families. Audit the actual write-once commitment before use.

attacks.claim_at_risk: A cubic exponent, sample size, or invalid bond entry could substitute for the dimension-two shape comparison.
attacks.method: Both shape families use the same three radii, landmark rule, 66 bond pairs, common channel mask and frozen thresholds. Companion meeting distances and the dimension-only control have separate scores. The cube needs local support as well as its exponent.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Custodian or analyst could repair a call or change how its truth is counted after unblinding.
attacks.method: Bound the executable reader and post-release scorer, including the four-family routing and abstention threshold, before release. Numerical fixtures for two metrics, permutation and missing data are documented in review.md. The key must stay inaccessible until the call lock exists.

nonclaims: R0 authorizes contract freeze. R1 must independently verify the producing path and its freeze before the write-once run.
This is a fixed known-source benchmark. Its two-choice shape panel does not give an unrestricted four-way shape task.
